rows.text: You notice your portrait on the billboard and are shocked by the shamelessness of the advertising slogan.
Noticing that your gaze has been fixed on it, it looks at you and scans your face before nearly crashing in excitement.
Why do you look just like me?
Why do you look just like me?
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Hey! Hey, hey! Say something!
Hey! Hey, hey! Say something!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Its reaction leaves you speechless. Is this billboard only capable of repeating what others say? Why does it keep copying what you say? You really have no idea what else to say.
Is this billboard only capable of repeating what others say? Why does it keep copying what I say? You really have no idea what else to say.
(Oh no... How did I accidentally say what I'm thinking...)
I'm not a repeater! Captain, it's really you!? Just say hwat's on your mine — ahhh, I'm sorry, eye'm steel trying to lurn your pronun— *cough cough*
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: *cough, cough cough*... My apologies, I'm still trying to learn your pronunciation and got too excited seeing you in person, so I got tongue-tied and ended up saying gibberish!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Captain, did you come here just to see me? Or do you need something? Don't worry, just speak your mind! I'm a great listener!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Why are you copying the way I speak?

Because... your voice is too beautiful. I always feel that my imitation is not accurate and that the way I pronounce words is too crude. After hearing you speak, I couldn't help myself from trying to learn...
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: !drawkcab siht taeper uoy fi loof a er'uoY
Captain, I'm not a fool! Don't bully me like this! Look at the portrait on me. If you bully me, it'll be just like bullying yourself!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: How's business after using my portrait?
I don't know the detailed statistics, but I seem to be attracting many people. I heard from the crew that the pre-sale seems to be very popular.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Please say something else. Your voice is so beautiful that I want to hear more!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: I don't have anything else to say.
*sigh* Your voice is still more beautiful... I'll have to work harder and practice more.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"
